id: title:Gilbert09:give a clear message for a rejected database password

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse credential authentication and error handling
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H1 demonstrates the addition of a user-friendly error constant `_INVALID_CREDENTIALS_ERROR` and a test asserting that password authentication failures no longer return `None` and do not include the host IP. This indicates a substantive improvement in warehouse connector reliability and user experience, replacing raw, potentially sensitive or confusing error
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the definition of the constant or the removal of the None values, so the implementation and removal are not fully verified, though the usage and test suggest the change is complete. No unverified outcomes are inferred.

observations.behavior: Adds a new constant `_INVALID_CREDENTIALS_ERROR` with a user-friendly message, and a new test asserting that password authentication failures no longer return `None` and do not include the host IP.
observations.posthog_connection: This change improves the error message returned to warehouse users when database credentials are rejected, removing the raw host/IP and replacing it with a clear instruction to check credentials.
